name: Mama Reido vol. 1 Sakie Mama Hen ~Koi o Shita no wa Shin'yuu no Mama Deshita~
original_name: ママ隷奴 vol.1 咲枝ママ編 ～恋をしたのは親友のママでした～
source:
Sakie is smitten with the innocent spirit of her son's best friend, Mahiro, and recently has been writing her own online novels based mainly on Mahiro, which she enjoys with other like-minded rotten girls.
But one day, she suddenly receives a threatening email from someone who knows about her online writing activities.
"If you don't want people to know about it, get Mahiro to become sexually active and make a video of it," was the threatening message, which left Sakie shaken.
If her corrupted otaku hobbies, which she has kept hidden all this time, are revealed, her current happy place in life will be gone.
Following the instructions in the email from the mysterious blackmailer, Sakie targets Mahiro, who has come to visit as usual.

translation:
咲枝迷恋儿子好友真祐纯真的气质，最近还以真祐为主要素材创作网络小说，和志同道合的腐女子一起享受其中。

然而某天，她突然收到一封来自知晓自己网络创作活动之人的威胁邮件。

“如果不想让别人知道，就让真祐发生性关系，并把过程拍成视频。”

威胁内容让咲枝震惊不已。如果自己一直隐藏的堕落宅女兴趣曝光，如今幸福的生活就会消失。

她遵照神秘勒索者邮件中的指示，把前来拜访的真祐当成目标。
